entities.summary: Celestino Mutis, a notable figure in the history of Colombia, associated with Late Colonial Society, Comuneros, and the Path to Independence (1700–1810). Preceded by Comunero Revolt and Antonio Nariño translated the Declaration. Their legacy influenced Comunero Revolt — 20,000 march on Bogotá, 1781 and Nariño translates Declaration of the Rights of Man.
